title: Melty Blood - Don't Check Your Mailbox! ~ GCV2005 (Remix)
description:
𝒜𝓇𝑒 𝓌𝑒 𝒾𝓃 𝐻𝑒𝓁𝓁?



Did an arrangement of GCV2005 from Melty Blood. Playing Tsukihime has done things to my brain, and I can't get Arcueid or that damn cat out of my head. They live inside it now, and they'll live inside yours too!!!

Seriously, though, this song actually slaps. Also has a sense of mystery as if "you don't belong here" whenever you have to fight Neco-Arc.
